Eating disorders include several conditions such as Anorexia Nervosa, Bulimia Nervosa, Binge Eating Disorder, and Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID). Each has unique symptoms and characteristics, but they all involve significant disturbances in eating behaviors and attitudes.
